universal_lens: The partnership pitch kit is modeled as a constrained optimization over a high-dimensional trust manifold. We define a creator alignment functional that maximizes expected long-term user retention while strictly penalizing boundary violations of brand safety and production system leakage.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats the pitch kit as a conformal prediction set for partner viability. By establishing strict disclosure boundaries, we bound the epistemic uncertainty of creator recommendations, ensuring that any extended affiliate network maintains calibrated probabilistic integrity without inflating false positive engagement metrics.
gse_mapping: Within GSE, this primitive acts as a state-transition gatekeeper. The situational reasoning engine evaluates proposed creator integrations against a static invariant set (no live billing/affiliate mutations), executing a safe rollback if the transition threatens the core sports intelligence environment's operational stability.

primitives.name: Brand Safety & Disclosure Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Copy / Brand Voice Needed Plain human copy, no fake certainty, no pressure, no method leakage, no irresponsible gambling language, and clear disclosure where required.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: Linguistic output space (dimensionless); D: Disclosure compliance indicator (Boolean); P: Pressure coefficient (normalized 0..1)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes linguistic outputs can be mapped to a vector space where 'fake certainty' and 'pressure' are quantifiable negative norms.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when regulatory frameworks shift rapidly or when adversarial actors attempt to bypass disclosure constraints via obfuscation.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a projection operator in Hilbert space that zeroes out vectors corresponding to prohibited gambling rhetoric, projecting all creator copy onto a subspace of verified transparency.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of generated copy flagged by NLP toxicity/safety classifiers; manual audit rejection rate.

primitives.name: Production System Isolation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not create live promotions, affiliate links, billing changes, or public AI advice without explicit approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_prod: Production state space; S_sandbox: Sandbox state space; Delta_S: State mutation magnitude (bytes/events)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a strict topological separation between the sandbox development environment and the live production infrastructure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the sandbox environment inadvertently inherits production secrets or if the isolation boundary is breached during deployment.

layer2.mapping: Derived from the principle of least privilege; acts as a zero-mutation kernel on the production database schema unless an explicit cryptographic approval signature is detected.
layer2.telemetry: Number of unauthorized write attempts to production tables; frequency of dry-run vs. live execution flags.

primitives.name: Atomic Rollback Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Stop before production data, public launch, live affiliate links, billing, or deploy.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t: Time of validation; C_t: System configuration at time t; R(C_t): Reversibility metric (0..1)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes all state changes introduced by the pitch kit implementation are atomic and possess a well-defined inverse operation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur if external dependencies (e.g., third-party creator APIs) introduce non-deterministic side effects that cannot be cleanly rolled back.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to a transactional commit/abort mechanism in distributed systems, ensuring the GSE situational model remains consistent even if a partner integration fails mid-execution.
layer2.telemetry: Mean time to rollback (MTTR); success rate of automated test suites validating pre-deployment states.

Our primitives act as a Nash equilibrium enforcement mechanism, aligning the creator's permissible actions with the platform's survival constraints, effectively translating the creator's aggressive growth vectors into safe, bounded exploratory movements within the approved sandbox.
